ITEM 1 | Bright red strawberry half-slice cut face up, glossy red, slightly seedy surface, pointed tip, about 4 cm long and 3 cm wide at base, sits at lower left of plate | 25
ITEM 2 | Whole red raspberries clustered, matte-to-slightly glossy, bumpy drupelet texture, deep red to pinkish, each about 1.5 cm, scattered in center-left | 45
ITEM 3 | Blackberries, dark purple-black, glossy with bumpy drupelets, roughly 2 cm each, two whole berries at top center and several in middle | 40
ITEM 4 | Blueberries, small dark blue-purple spheres with smooth waxy skin, about 1 cm diameter, scattered around the fruit cluster and near sausages | 25
ITEM 5 | Pineapple chunks, bright yellow with slightly darker edges, cut into irregular wedge pieces about 2.5 cm by 1.5 cm and 1 cm thick, juicy-looking, several pieces at left and center | 65
ITEM 6 | Scrambled eggs, pale yellow to golden with soft curds, moist but holding loose clumps, irregular piled mound about 10 cm by 7 cm and 1.5 cm high, right side of plate | 110
ITEM 7 | Cooked sausage rounds, light tan to grey-brown, matte with slight browning, cylindrical slices about 2.5 cm diameter and 1.5 cm thick, four to five pieces stacked in a column in center-right | 85
ITEM 8 | Darker browned sausage links or rounds, deep brown with grill-mark-like browning and slight shine, about 2.5 cm diameter, placed near the eggs at right | 45
ITEM 9 | Roasted sweet potato cubes, bright orange flesh with caramelized brown edges, soft, cut into irregular cubes about 2.5 cm, lower right of plate | 60
ITEM 10 | Small dark brown browned round piece, glossy skin with slight char, about 2.5 cm diameter, at far right edge near the sweet potato | 20
